description: DRAFT. A grant authorising one device to use a capability offered by another. Stored by the device that issued it; not shared. The namespace org.ligatureprotocol is a placeholder; the domain is not yet registered.

main.description: Record of an explicit capability grant, held by the grantor.

grantor.description: deviceId of the device offering the capability.

grantee.description: deviceId of the device permitted to use it. May belong to another identity in a household.

granteeDid.description: DID of the grantee's identity when it differs from the grantor's.

capability.description: NSID of the granted capability type.

scope.description: Capability-specific restriction on what the grantee may do. Schema defined by the capability type.

approvedBy.description: DID of the person who approved a cross-identity grant: the capability's owner, or the person present on the device for a device-scoped capability. Absent for implicit same-identity grants and for grants made by device policy.

standing.description: True when the approver chose to remember the answer; false for a one-time approval.

expiresAt.description: Absent means the grant does not expire.
